name: pin-hold-v2
about: B1 (review-f3-arm-scope, fix-nav-morph): reproduce P-036's capped end. Transit strokes (P-036's still profile, 480 px / 700 ms, hold 150) from the top until atEnd or 24 passes: when the morph pins the page at y 5215 (5 px short of the end) the loop keeps pushing into the pin like P-036's capped runs (10 passes there), then the page idles 8 s at the pin. v2 (lead, round 2): then two close/open cycles at the pin (a 240 px / 500 ms down stroke closes the morph; 2 s later a 240 px / 500 ms up stroke reopens it; 2 s pause after each), so the frames where D arms and disarms its window touch listeners can be read beside C and V.
